items.headline: Richard returns in top form, runs for 204 yards in Hoosiers' rout
items.description: Eight days after he limped off with a right ankle injury, Indiana star rusher Turbo Richard burned Rutgers for a career-best 204 yards and a touchdown in the Hoosiers' 45-17 road win.

items.headline: Richard runs for 204 yards, TD in No. 6 Indiana's 47-15 romp over Rutgers
items.description: — Turbo Richard ran for 204 yards and a touchdown, Josh Hoover passed for 251 yards and four touchdowns and No. 6 Indiana beat Rutgers 47-15 on Saturday night for its 21st straight victory.
